newsitem.title: UK: Two May 1-3 Brent cargoes clocked, third kept-trade.
newsitem.headline: Two May 1-3 Brent cargoes clocked, third kept-trade.

text.p: Two of the first three May Brent cargoes nominated loading dates were unclaimed at the five o'clock deadline on Wednesday, traders said.
The cargoes, due to load May 1-3, were clocked to Shell and Sinochem, they said. Shell also kept the third cargo assigned those dates.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
